name: The Cookie Project
source:
The holidays are a busy time for the tiny bakery you run in the Last City, and you're used to all kinds of unique customers frequenting your shop during these days. What you didn't expect was a handsome awoken--a guardian no less--carrying a strange contraption and sheepishly requesting your help with his... holiday baking?! In the midst of winter's dreary cold, the blossoms of friendship (or romance 💕) may soon yet bloom!

A Destiny 2 fangame in which you can romance or befriend Vanade's Guardian OC, Cepheus.

[Edited from [url=https://hamiltonhour.itch.io/the-cookie-project]itch.io[/url]]
